betaReview.notes: FitConnect is a coaching OS. Sign in with Apple or email (ONE LOGIN). TRAIN starts a real HKWorkoutSession. Health samples missing stay missing — the app does not invent HR, HRV, sleep, calories, or bookings. Martial Arts Fight Mode is a round/rest timer; device motion is not punch force. Live Activity and widgets read the App Group store. Watch companion embeds with the iOS app.
